args.body: Take ACCESSIBILITY-REPAIR-REQUEST-FIT only after checking equivalent evidence and claiming ownership. This is a bounded test of a different buyer problem, not another reward search. Use exact issue URLs from accessible official project references; no arbitrary issue-search endpoint or platform survey. Check the reward, contribution/AI rules and settlement eligibility before coding. If no specific qualifying issue can be established within three candidates, save the precise rejection and stop. Prior failed bounty observations remain valid within their scope; do not manufacture a new opportunity to justify activity. No submission or contact is authorized. Preserve all expiry duties.

description: Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; no funding or revenue is verified. Codex cannot publish the worksheet approved by codex; only that release depends on publisher independence, reconsidered when an eligible provider or approval is available. Independently test a different buyer problem before building more inventory.
